description: Verify that Client Mode without explicit Subscribe trigger — DUT must not auto-subscribe
approach:
[Objective]
Client mode boundary: subscriptions are explicit user actions — DUT must not subscribe just because an OfferService matches.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. UT does NOT trigger explicit Subscribe.
3. Observation: DUT must NOT emit Subscribe.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT silent without explicit trigger — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_dut_subscribed_without_trigg: DUT emitted subscribe without explicit trigger
